title: Grand Mausoleum Offerings Key

sources.title: Grand Mausoleum Offerings Key
markers: {{story|Grand Mausoleum Offerings Key}} is a miscellaneous [[:Category:Keys|key]]. It can be used to access a nearby chest.

summary: Two keys each unlock a different Opulent Chest in the Lower City’s Ancient Mausoleum.

fields.Use: Unlock the two Opulent Chests at X 1092 or 1097, Y 855 in the Ancient Mausoleum. This is the Lower City location.
fields.Acquisition: Open the sarcophagus with DC 15 Strength. Opening it also triggers three Void cloud vents, detectable with DC 15 Perception and resisted with DC 10 Dexterity.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
